mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates and increases equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in FEDFUNDS < 1.0% periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 3.0% signals a tightening cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 3.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increase in payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a strong labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint movement (UNRATE decline and PAYEMS increase) does not lead to positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a decline in retail sales (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer demand that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion periods, a decline in RSAFS does not lead to negative 20-day returns (i.e., returns are positive or zero in >50% of cases), or the Rank IC for RSAFS in late-cycle is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong demand for residential construction, which boosts economic activity and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST does not lead to positive 5-day returns (mean return <=0) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (index, 2017=100) signals a contraction in manufacturing and supply chain disruptions that reduce corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 100 does not lead to negative 60-day returns (i.e., returns are positive or zero in >50% of cases), or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a tight labor market with monetary tightening, which increases the risk of recession and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening with strong labor market
failure_condition: The joint movement (FEDFUNDS up and UNRATE down) does not lead to negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A lower unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a tight labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE does not lead to positive 5-day returns (mean return <=0) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
